title: 第26章 得宝突破第27章 都是宝贝
slug: 剑里乾坤第3107章不似作伪
content_zh:
突然他想起小时候听师父和蔡爷爷他们喝酒聊天，说蛇胆是好东西。他就转身来到那堆内脏旁边，用匕首在里面扒拉着，终于他看见了比他拳头还要大的蛇胆。他连忙用匕首把蛇胆割了下来，就在他转身要离开的时候，他发现刚刚蛇胆位置还有一粒鸡蛋大小，一粒圆溜溜的红色珠子，很是漂亮，于是他弯腰把这粒珠子也拣了起来！
卓然把自己的外套下摆割了一块布下来，把蛇胆包了起来。随即他又拿起那粒红色的圆珠，仔细的打量了起来，洞内光线太暗，卓然就拿着走到洞口，他仰起头举起这粒珠子对准太阳，他就感觉这粒珠子好像是半透明似的，里面好像还有还有棉花一样的东西，突然他手指一滑，那粒珠子从手指之间滑落下来，卓然不由张嘴“啊！”了一声，说巧不巧那粒红色珠子就掉进了他的嘴里，他自然而然的一闭嘴，那粒珠子居然被他吞了下去，他连忙用手去嘴里去抠，可是那粒红色珠子已经顺着喉咙滑了下去，卓然不由着急起来，因为他也不知道这东西有没有毒，就在这时他感觉，自己丹田里面好像有一块火炭在燃烧，同时丹田里面好像有一股气体在膨胀，马上就要把自己丹田撑破似的，这时他突然想起小时候第一次吞那粒“洗经增元丹”时的场景，他连忙盘腿而坐，运功引导着那团热气在自己全身的经脉游走，一个周天，两个周天，三个周天，此时的卓然只感觉每一条经脉，每一处穴位，浑身都被一股热流充满了，他感觉自己就要被撑炸了！而丹田里面还在源源不断的产生大量的火热气体，随着热流越来越多，越来越浓，卓然突然感觉自己的任督二脉正在被两股热流冲击着，第一次冲击并没有突破，但是也把卓然疼的额头冒汗，第二次冲击力量比第一次更大，但是又没成功，疼的卓然差点就喊出来，卓然连忙稳定心情，运功配合引导这股热流冲击任督二脉，一次，二次，三次，终于在钻心的疼痛中冲破了任督二脉，那股热流就如同开闸的洪水一般，瞬间就涌进了任督二脉，卓然突然有一种前所没有的舒泰，同时这股热流正在和自己的内力在融合，他不敢大意，继续引导着热流在身体里面继续又远行了三个周天以后，直到这股热流和自己内力完全融合，这才把内力引导至丹田里面，这时他感觉自己的丹田比以前容量大了不少，已经完全可以容纳这股合并的内力。
卓然这时站了起来，只感觉浑身精力充沛，充满了力量，他就在山洞里面练了一套掌法，卓然只感觉威力比以前大了太多，掌风也比以前更凌厉了，练到兴起之时，他一掌拍向一颗一人粗的石柱，就听轰的一声，那颗石柱被这一掌拍的四分五裂，轰然倒塌，也就在石柱倒塌的同时，突然洞壁上一扇石门缓缓打开，又露出一个洞口，突然出现的洞口把卓然也吓了一跳，原来这山洞里面还有一个山洞，他连忙把匕首又握在手中，慢慢的向洞口靠近，等到他进到洞内以后，他只觉得眼前豁然一亮，他连忙揉了揉眼睛，让自己眼睛适应了一下，他才仔细打量这个山洞里面，就见山洞最高处放着一颗夜明珠，把整个山洞都照的如同白昼一般，夜明珠下方大大小小的摆着二十多个木箱，在那些木箱旁边有一块很是平整的石头，上面有一具骷髅，只是卓然怎么看那具骷髅怎么不对劲，但是他这时也知道这是那人的坟墓了，他无意中进了别人的葬身之地，他连忙走到那具骷髅面前磕了几个头说道“晚辈无意冒犯，还请前辈不要怪罪晚辈！”说完他抬头看向那具骷髅，这才知道自己为什么看这具骷髅不正常，原来这具骷髅是黑色的，一看就是中了很厉害的毒，毒发身亡的。在骷髅的面前还有一张字条和一本书，可能由于时间太长的缘故，纸条和书都已经泛黄了！卓然小心翼翼的拿起那张纸条看了起来，只见上面写着“进来看见我这张字条就是有缘人，洞内一切皆是留给有缘人，只求帮我尸体入土为安！”最后的署名是“钻天龙”！张名扬把字条放下，又拿起那本书，就看见封面上写着“追风飘渺步”卓然简单翻了几下，看出来这是一部练习轻功的秘诀，他就把书放进怀里，转身走向那些木箱子那里，他打开第一个木箱，就见里面全部都是名贵的珠宝，他又接连打开好几个箱子，里面都是金银珠宝！他知道这些木箱里面应该都是这些东西了，这些东西他都不知道要值多少钱，就随便拿一个箱子出去，都可以富甲一方！何况这里是二十多个木箱子！他又抬头看向那颗夜明珠，就心想这颗夜明珠的价值应该是价值连城了吧！想到这里他双脚一点地，就飞向那颗夜明珠，谁知他现在功力大增，一不小心，头都碰到山洞顶部了，碰的他眼冒金星，但是他同时也看见那颗夜明珠下面还有一个长条型的木匣子，他落到地面，揉了揉刚刚被撞的头顶，又是轻轻一点飞向那颗夜明珠，他快速的抓起那粒夜明珠同时另外一只手抓起那个木匣，一个翻身落到地面上，只见木匣上面写着“红云白龙剑”他打开那个木匣，木匣里面放着一柄宝剑，就见这柄宝剑通体都是白色的，剑鞘不知是什么材料做的，拿在手里只感觉十分柔软很舒服，剑柄是象牙做的这个卓然是认识的，上面还镶嵌了一大四小五颗红宝石，做工极其精美！卓然把剑抽出剑鞘的时候，发出一阵龙吟声，卓然只感觉剑气逼人，红光四射，剑长2尺1寸，通体赤红，剑身上面还刻有一条白龙，活灵活现，栩栩如生，就好像随时都要腾云驾雾离开一般！厚薄适中，剑锋也是锋利无比，拿在手里轻重也很合适。卓然拿在手里比划了几下，感觉手感很舒服！卓然知道这是一柄宝剑！他把宝剑挂在腰间，又从木箱子里面选了几件东西放进怀里，他又走到那具骷髅面前弯腰说道“钻天龙前辈，您说的这里东西归我的，我才拿的，我改天过来帮您入土为安！”说完他就向山洞外面走去，走到洞口他才把夜明珠放进怀里，他来到洞口施展出壁虎功又向崖顶爬去，由于功力大增，他上去的时候比下来的时候快多了！很快就来到崖顶！他看了看太阳，已经是黄昏时间了。他连忙双脚一点地，人就如同飞起来一般向山下狂奔！这速度比刚刚上山时间可是快了不少！

Suddenly he remembered that when he was a child, he heard his master and Grandpa Cai chatting while drinking, saying that snake gall is a good thing. He turned around and came to the pile of viscera, digging through it with his dagger. Finally he saw the snake gallbladder bigger than his fist. He quickly cut off the snake's gallbladder with a dagger. Just when he turned to leave, he found that there was a round red bead the size of an egg in the snake's gallbladder. It was very beautiful, so he bent down and picked up the bead too!
Zhuoran cut off a piece of cloth from the hem of his coat and wrapped the snake gallbladder. Then he picked up the red bead and looked at it carefully. The light in the cave was too dark, so Zhuoran took it to the entrance of the cave. He raised his head and raised the bead to point it at the sun. He felt that the bead seemed to be translucent, and there seemed to be something like cotton inside. Suddenly his finger slipped, and the bead appeared. The beads slipped from between his fingers. Zhuo Ran couldn't help but opened his mouth and said "Ah!", saying that by chance, the red bead fell into his mouth. He naturally shut up and swallowed the bead. He quickly went to his mouth to pick it with his hands, but the red bead had already slipped down his throat. , Zhuoran couldn't help but become anxious, because he didn't know if this thing was poisonous. At this moment, he felt as if a piece of coal was burning in his Dantian, and at the same time, there seemed to be a gas expanding in his Dantian, which was about to burst his Dantian. At this time, he suddenly remembered the first time he swallowed that pill when he was a child. In the scene when "Cleaning the Menstruation and Zengyuan Dan", he quickly sat cross-legged and used his skills to guide the hot air to travel through the meridians all over his body. One week, two weeks, three weeks. At this time, Zhuo Ran only felt that every meridian and every acupuncture point was filled with a stream of heat. He felt like he was about to be exploded! A large amount of hot gas was still being continuously produced in the Dantian. As the heat flow became more and more intense, Zhuo Ran suddenly felt that his Rendu Second Meridian was being impacted by two heat currents. The first impact did not break through, but it also caused Zhuo Ran's forehead pain. His head was sweating, and the force of the second impact was greater than the first, but it was unsuccessful. Zhuo Ran almost cried out in pain. Zhuo Ran quickly stabilized his mood, and used his skills to guide the heat flow to impact the Ren and Du meridian once, twice, and three times. Finally, he was in excruciating pain. After breaking through the Ren and Du meridians, the hot current was like a flood that opened up and poured into the Ren and Du meridians in an instant. Zhuoran suddenly felt an unprecedented sense of comfort. At the same time, this hot flow was merging with his own inner strength. He did not dare to be careless and continued to guide the hot flow in his body. After traveling for three more weeks in his body, it was not until this heat flow completely merged with his own internal energy that he guided the internal energy into his Dantian. At this time, he felt that his Dantian had a much larger capacity than before and could fully accommodate this combined internal force.
Zhuo Ran stood up at this time and felt that his whole body was full of energy and strength. He practiced a set of palm techniques in the cave. Zhuo Ran only felt that the power was much greater than before, and the palm wind was also sharper than before. When he got up to practice, he struck a palm with one palm. A stone pillar as thick as a person was heard, and with a bang, the stone pillar was torn into pieces by this palm strike, and suddenly collapsed. At the same time as the stone pillar collapsed, suddenly a stone door on the cave wall slowly opened, revealing another hole. The sudden appearance of the hole shocked Zhuo Ran. He was also startled. It turned out that there was another cave inside this cave. He quickly held the dagger in his hand and slowly approached the entrance of the cave. When he entered the cave, he felt that his eyes suddenly lit up. He quickly rubbed his eyes to let his eyes adapt. After a while, he carefully looked inside the cave. He saw a luminous pearl placed at the highest point of the cave, illuminating the entire cave as if it were daytime. Below the luminous pearl were more than twenty wooden boxes of various sizes. Beside those wooden boxes, there was a veryThere was a skeleton on the flat stone, but Zhuo Ran thought something was wrong with the skeleton, but at this time he also knew that it was that person's grave. He accidentally entered someone else's burial place. He quickly walked to the skeleton and kowtowed a few times and said He said, "I don't mean to offend, senior. Please don't blame the junior!" After saying that, he raised his head and looked at the skeleton. Only then did he realize why he looked at the skeleton abnormally. It turned out that the skeleton was black. At first glance, it seemed that he had been poisoned by a very powerful poison and died from the poison. There is a note and a book in front of the skeleton. Perhaps due to the long time, the note and the book have turned yellow! Zhuo Ran carefully picked up the note and read it, only to see that it said, "Come in and see this note from me. It's the destined person. Everything in the cave is reserved for the destined person. I just want to help my body be buried in peace!" The last signature is "Zhuan Tianlong"! Zhang Mingyang put down the note and picked up the book again. He saw on the cover it said "Chasing the Wind and Mist Steps". Zhuo Ran flipped through it a few times and saw that it was a secret book on practicing Qing Gong. He put the book in his arms and turned around and walked towards the wooden boxes. He opened the first wooden box and saw that it was all filled with precious jewelry. He opened several more boxes in succession, and they were all filled with gold and silver jewelry! He knew that these wooden boxes should be full of these things. He didn't even know how much these things were worth, so he could make a fortune just by taking out any box! What's more, there are more than twenty wooden boxes here! He looked up at the luminous pearl again, thinking that the value of this luminous pearl should be priceless! Thinking of this, he touched the ground with his feet and flew towards the luminous pearl. Unexpectedly, his skill was greatly enhanced now. He accidentally touched his head on the top of the cave. Stars appeared in his eyes when he hit it. But at the same time, he also saw a long wooden box under the luminous pearl. He fell to the ground, rubbed the head of his head that had just been hit, and flew to the luminous pearl lightly. He quickly grabbed the luminous pearl and grabbed it with his other hand. Picking up the wooden box, he turned over and fell to the ground. He saw "Red Cloud White Dragon Sword" written on the wooden box. He opened the wooden box. There was a sword in the wooden box. He saw that the sword was all white. The scabbard was made of an unknown material. It just felt very soft and comfortable in the hand. The hilt was made of ivory, which Zhuoran knew. It was also inlaid with one large, four small and five rubies. The workmanship was extremely exquisite! When Zhuo Ran took the sword out of its scabbard, there was a burst of dragon roar. Zhuo Ran felt that the sword was powerful and red light was shining everywhere. The sword was 2 feet 1 inch long and was red in color. There was also a white dragon engraved on the sword body. It was vivid and lifelike, as if it was about to fly away in the clouds and mist at any moment! The thickness is moderate, the blade is extremely sharp, and the weight is just right in your hand. Zhuoran held it in his hand and made a few gestures, feeling that it felt very comfortable! Zhuoran knew this was a sword! He hung the sword on his waist, and selected a few things from the wooden box and put them in his arms. He walked to the skeleton and bent down and said, "Senior Zhuan Tianlong, the things you mentioned here belong to me. I just took them. I will come over to help you put them in some other time." The earth is safe!" After saying that, he walked out of the cave. When he reached the entrance of the cave, he put the night pearl into his arms. He came to the entrance of the cave and performed the gecko skill and climbed to the top of the cliff. Due to the greatly increased skill, he went up much faster than when he came down! Soon we will reach the top of the cliff! He looked at the sun and saw that it was already dusk. He quickly touched the ground with his feet, and he ran down the mountain as if he were flying! This speed is much faster than the time I just went up the mountain!
